test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A work can be completed by 20 men in 50 days. 30 more than join them after 10 days of work. How many days will be saved in completion of the work?
solution:
Given,

20 men can finish a work = 50 days

Formula:

Total work = Efficiency × Time

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Calculation:

Let the number of days taken after the increment of 30 people be x.

According to the question

Total work = 50 × 20

50 × 20 = 20 × 10 + 50 × x

⇒ 50 × x = 800

⇒ x = 16

Total time taken is 10 + 16 = 26

Number of days saved = 50 - 26 = 24

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
